description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the ThingSearchCommandAdapter class, which handles the conversion between internal representations of thing search commands and their adaptable JSON payloads, specifically in the context of Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter’s functionality.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: A JUnit-based unit test class for testing conversion logic of the ThingSearchCommandAdapter, including creating adaptables from commands and vice versa, as well as handling unknown commands.

classes.name: UnknownThingSearchCommand
classes.description: A mock implementation of ThingSearchCommand for testing unknown command handling within the adapter.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ThingSearchCommandAdapter instance before each test.

methods.name: unknownCommandToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests that an UnknownThingSearchCommand triggers an UnknownCommandException when converting to adaptable.

methods.name: createSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of a CreateSubscription command to an Adaptable object.

methods.name: createSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of a CreateSubscription command to an Adaptable object with specific header and payload structure.

methods.name: createSubscriptionFilterOnlyToAdaptable
methods.description: Checks conversion of a subscription command with only a filter set.

methods.name: createSubscriptionWithFieldsFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creating an adapter from a payload that includes fields.

methods.name: createSubscriptionWithFieldsToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creating an Adaptable from a command with fields.

methods.name: requestSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies that a RequestFromSubscription command converts correctly from Adaptable.

methods.name: requestSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of a RequestFromSubscription command to Adaptable with the correct payload.

methods.name: cancelSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a CancelSubscription command from Adaptable.

methods.name: cancelSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a CancelSubscription command to an Adaptable with the correct payload.
